description: This Java class defines and manages view entities within the OFBiz framework, extending standard entity modeling to include view-specific features such as linkages, aliasing, conditions, and conversions. It supports parsing from XML, handling complex alias expressions, and generating SQL fragments for view-based queries.

classes.name: ModelViewEntity
classes.description: Represents a complex view entity in the OFBiz data model, extending ModelEntity to support view-specific features like join links, aliases, conditions, and data conversions.

methods.name: populateFields
methods.description: Populates the fields of the view entity, including forward and reverse links from member entities and alias definitions.

methods.name: populateFieldsBasic
methods.description: Assigns fields to the view entity based on member entity definitions, aliases, and alias-all expansions.

methods.name: getAliasedEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the actual ModelEntity corresponding to a given alias, using the model reader.

methods.name: expandAllAliasAlls
methods.description: Expands configured alias-all definitions into individual alias entries for each field of referenced member entities.

methods.name: populateReverseLinks
methods.description: Builds bidirectional linkages between view entity aliases and related entity fields, essential for query optimization.

methods.name: makeViewEntityConditionList
methods.description: Creates an XML element representing a list of conditions with optional combination operator.

methods.name: makeViewEntityConditionExpr
methods.description: Constructs an XML expression element for a view entity condition, with multiple overloads for different parameter sets.
